messages.content: Read only the current facts and question and return every coherent factual view. Identify the queried person and year. Extract directed decrees of divorce or separate maintenance. Use ongoing_from only where the text or native case semantics supports that the decree/status continues from the effective date; use effective_only where only the dated decree is supported and its later persistence is not established; use closed_interval only when both endpoints are supported. Do not invent an end date or assume arbitrary future permanence. Use [] only after resolving the finite case and finding no qualifying decree, and null for unread or failed extraction. Each view must contain nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question. Do not determine statutory marital status, applicability, eligibility, entailment, contradiction, or any final legal answer.
